mike: FYI saw a perf regression on dedicated after the kernel selector tweak this morning :warning:
raj: saw it too. token-level latencies up on long-decode paths. reproducing on canary.
ellie: where are the spikes? prefix vs decode?
raj: mainly decode. KV cache hit rate unchanged. suspect kernel selection chooses a slower matmul kernel for certain seq lengths.
raj: quick dump from profiler (trimmed):
```
request_id=abc123
seq_len=1024
kernel_choice=matmul_v2_fallback
kernel_time_ms=42.7
kv_cache_lookup_ms=1.8
token_decode_ms_avg=45.9
batch_wait_ms=3.2
```
ellie: thanks. can you paste the route + model? need to check per-route KPIs in the dashboard.
raj: route=/v1/generate/model=gptx-8k-dedicated
mike: dashboard shows per-route 95th token-latency jumped from 18ms -> 55ms at 03:12 UTC, correlated with a rollout of kernel-selector v2.1
infra-bot: deploy v2.1 to pooled-gpu completed 1718601000 :white_check_mark:
ellie: ok, actionable items: 1) add token-level breakdown to the route KPI panel (kernel_select, kernel_exec, kv_lookup, batch_wait) 2) add an alert on latency burn rate for per-route 95th >= 2x baseline for 5m 3) revert kernel selector canary until we have kernel heuristics fixed.
mike: on the alerting note — current paging threshold is 95th > 50ms for 2m. that's too sensitive for transient noise. propose burn-rate style: if 95th > 2x baseline for 5m -> page oncall.
oncall-ops: agreed. baseline calc should be rolling 7d median per-route and per-model, excluding rollouts. we can wire in anomaly detection to ignore planned deploy windows if tagged.
ellie: I'll add panels and a small instrumentation change: emit token_latency.{kernel_select,kernel_exec,kv_lookup,batch_wait} tags by route+model+seq_bucket.
raj: also adding a sampling trace for full KV path to see cold misses. kv_hits are stable but we might be paying for cache read amplification per token.
mike: makes sense. ellie pls add a short dashboard note and link to the profiling trace. set alert to severity=page, runbook=links/playbooks/eng-runtime-kernel-regress.md
ellie: will do. quick patch: pin kernel-selector to v2.0 on dedicated for rollback in 15m unless canary shows no regressions in next 30m.
raj: test script I ran: `./tools/run_e2e --model gptx-8k-dedicated --seq 1024 --concurrency 8 --profile tokens` produced the attached numbers. will paste detailed logs in #eng-sre.
mike: thanks. ellie, raj — update this thread when dashboard+alerts are live. :thumbsup:
oncall-ops: paging policy updated in ops-config: `page_if(burn_rate(95th, 5m) > 2.0 && sustained(5m))` ; testing alerts in staging now. :eyes:
ellie: dashboard panels added and instrumentation PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/4821 — includes metric names and alert rule. linking runbook.
mike: closing loop — rollback scheduled if canary fails. good catch everyone.
__notes: Slack thread about kernel selection regression, profiling, dashboard metrics, and alerting. Messages are in chronological order and include code blocks and bot messages.
